images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Ranch houses

facade.notes: Lucas County Auditor block card: a 1960s ranch with a dark wood-shake wainscot on the end and white siding above, a ribbon of windows and a picture window by the door, a breezeway to a detached garage beside it, a TV antenna mast; an open, almost treeless lot at the city's edge with power lines along the road

why.note: edge-of-city lots on old farm roads: wide, treeless, unsewered at first
the breezeway keeps the garage separate but under one roof line: covered passage in snow
